artifacts.summary: Round-2 verification of the trans-redesign: machine-checked probe shows Families A and B satisfy all six redesigned conditions with trans = eq and refute both congruences, stabFamily is not liftable (closure field necessary), Liftable suffices for the histories characterization; candidates B and C closed; re-proof surface corrected to 36 sites in 9 files.

next_steps: Plan phase: copy the probe's TLocalCoherent/TThread/Liftable/ArrivalPruned signatures and the total_eq_tthread_of_liftable proof into Phases 1-2, the famA/famB families into Phase 4, and use the F6 36-site grep as the Phase 2 checklist; fold task 694 into this task.

memory_candidates.content: On PlusFormula closure enumerations, plain simp [PlusFormula.subformulas, PlusFormula.top] over plusSubformulaClosure membership hits the 200000-heartbeat whnf limit; the working form is rw [mem_plusClosureOf]; simp only [List.mem_*]; rw [plusSubformulaClosure, List.mem_toFinset]; simp only [PlusFormula.top, PlusFormula.subformulas, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]; tauto.

In a position-labelled branching certificate a position's label is the truth set of every history through it, so all trans-neighbours of a position must agree on the one-step untl/snce unfoldings; that residue is semantically forced and distinct from the share-class collapse defect, which arises only when the one-step reach is a whole share-class.
